title: Cricket Leagues Around the World
description: The major Twenty20 and domestic cricket leagues from across the globe

leagues.name: Indian Premier League (IPL)
leagues.description: The richest cricket league in the world — 8-10 teams play a round-robin then knockout format every March–May
leagues.prize_money: Over 20 crore rupees ($2.5 million) for the winning team
leagues.viewership: Over 500 million viewers watch the IPL in India alone
fun_facts: The IPL generates more revenue than any cricket tournament in the world
Players from over 40 countries have played in the IPL
MS Dhoni is the only captain to win the IPL more than 4 times

leagues.name: Big Bash League (BBL)
leagues.description: Australia's T20 league — known for family-friendly entertainment and world-class cricket during the Australian summer
fun_facts: Games are played on beaches and famous grounds like the MCG
Introduced the Bash Boost (bonus point) and X-Factor player rules — the most innovative cricket rules in the world

leagues.name: Pakistan Super League (PSL)
leagues.description: Pakistan's premier T20 league — has grown rapidly and now attracts top international talent
fun_facts: Started in UAE but now played fully in Pakistan — a huge achievement for cricket's return to Pakistan
Lahore Qalandars were runners-up 4 times before finally winning in 2022 then again in 2023

leagues.name: Caribbean Premier League (CPL)
leagues.description: The Caribbean's T20 festival — cricket mixed with carnival culture, music and island life
fun_facts: Games feature live music and dancing in the stands
Has helped revive West Indian cricket — many young talents now play internationally after breaking through in the CPL
Trinbago Knight Riders (TKR) are the most successful team with 4 titles

leagues.name: SA20
leagues.description: South Africa's brand-new IPL-backed T20 league — already attracting world-class players
fun_facts: All 6 franchises are owned by IPL franchises
Sunrisers Eastern Cape won the first two editions
Considered the second-best T20 league after the IPL

leagues.name: The Hundred
leagues.description: England's revolutionary 100-ball competition — designed to attract new fans with a faster format
fun_facts: Teams are city-based: London Spirit, Manchester Originals, Oval Invincibles, etc.
Both men's and women's competitions run simultaneously in the same venues
First cricket format specifically designed for TV with 25-ball intervals and set breaks

leagues.name: Major Test Series
leagues.description: The oldest and most prestigious format — Test cricket tests patience, skill and character like nothing else

famous_series.name: The Ashes
famous_series.description: The greatest cricket rivalry — started in 1882 when a satirical obituary said English cricket had died and the ashes would be taken to Australia
famous_series.fun_fact: The actual Ashes is a tiny urn with a burnt cricket bail inside, kept at Lord's Cricket Ground

famous_series.name: India-Pakistan Test Series
famous_series.description: The most watched cricket series when played — hundreds of millions tune in across both countries

famous_series.name: Border-Gavaskar Trophy
famous_series.description: Named after two greats — Allan Border and Sunil Gavaskar — now one of cricket's most intense rivalries

famous_series.name: India-England Test Series
famous_series.description: The Pataudi Trophy — two great cricketing nations with a rich shared history
